question: Who among the following sportspersons received the prestigious Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in August 2020?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mariyappan T.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Mariyappan Thangavelu is a **Paralympic high jumper.**
 
• He **received the prestigious Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award in August 2020.**
 
• He is being rewarded for hi**s gold medal in the 2016 Rio Paralympics in the** **T-42 high jump category.** T-42 applies to athletes with a single above-the-knee amputation or a disability that is comparable.
 
• He is** India's first Paralympian gold medalist since 2004.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Rajiv Gandhi Khel Ratna Award:**

 
 
• It is given for the spectacular and most outstanding performance in the field of sports by the sportsperson over a period of four years.
 
• The first recipient of the award was Chess Grandmaster Vishwanathan Anand.
 
• It has a reward of Rs. 25 lakh rupees.
 
• The 2020 recipients of the award are as follows:
 
 
• **Rohit Sharma (Cricket)**
 
• **Mariyappan Thangavelu (Para-Athletics)**
 
• **Manika Batra (Table Tennis)**
 
• **Vinesh Phogat (Wrestling)**
 
• **Rani Rampal (Hockey.**
